edit_instruction: Boost the vibrant crispness of the salad greens and carrots for a fresher appearance. Apply a subtle golden warmth and richer brown hues to the grilled steak, mushrooms, and pine nuts, enhancing their appetizing appeal. Increase textural contrast across all food elements, ensuring brighter specular highlights and deeper, more defined shadows, while preserving the clean luminosity of the white plate.

Introduce warm, late-afternoon sunlight from an unseen window on the left, casting soft, elongated shadows of the person and kite frame onto the beige tiled floor, imbuing the scene with a cozy ambiance and subtle contrast, while meticulously preserving the rough, natural texture of the wooden sticks and the translucent quality of the white plastic sheeting.

Boost the vibrancy and saturation of the sandwich fillings, particularly the fresh green lettuce and the reddish meat, to appear more appetizing and distinct, while subtly softening the harsh direct sunlight and minimizing shadows on the grass and brown paper to create a more diffused, inviting afternoon glow, ensuring the natural textures of the ingredients and paper are retained.

Re-light the entire scene to simulate a warm, late-afternoon golden hour, casting long, soft shadows from the upper-right across the natural wood grain of the table and the patrons, infusing the environment with deep golden and amber hues, while preserving the natural skin tones and vibrant colors of the pizzas, ensuring a rich, photoreal depth and enhanced mood.

Illuminate the scene with the warm, golden light of a late afternoon sun, casting soft, elongated shadows from the buildings towards the left, while enriching the red brick tones of the buildings and the deep green of the awnings to appear more vibrant, ensuring the bustling street activity and distinct architectural details remain unchanged.

Introduce a dynamic, forward-facing key light from the upper-left, illuminating the faces and controllers of the primary group of players with a vibrant, slightly cool-toned glow, casting subtle, elongated shadows behind them on the dark blue carpet, while concurrently deepening the contrast and richness of the background banner's blue and white circular motif, ensuring the authenticity of skin textures and clothing details remains paramount.

Brighten the entire interior scene significantly, especially the fresh produce in the foreground and the bread display, adding a soft, warm glow to the baked goods to emphasize their golden crust and fluffy texture, while ensuring the natural skin tones of the people remain unaffected and the background details are still clearly visible with improved contrast.

Boost the vibrancy and saturation of the oranges and pears, making them appear exceptionally fresh and ripe with a subtle, dewy sheen, while gently softening the overall shadows to create a warmer, more inviting market ambiance. Ensure the natural textures of all fruits remain distinct and the abundant display is preserved.

Deepen the worn dark wood kitchen cabinets to a uniform, rich espresso tone with a satin finish, enhancing their texture and providing a sleek, updated look. Remove the white trash bin and the purple bucket of items from the floor, decluttering the foreground for a cleaner aesthetic. Preserve the vibrant orange wall color, all white appliances, and the distinctive plant and surfboard decor without alteration.

Gently brighten the entire kitchen scene, introducing a soft, warm ambient light that effectively illuminates under-cabinet shadows and enhances countertop reflections, while subtly enriching the existing oak cabinet wood tone to a honeyed, satin finish, ensuring all current objects remain in place with their original textures and precise positioning.
